listening.title: Calling a partner about a delivery

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: Good afternoon, ABC Logistics. This is Thu speaking. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Hello Thu, this is Nam from Delta Software. Could I speak to Mr. Khoa, please?

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: I am sorry, could you speak up? I think we have poor reception here.

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Is this better? I am calling about the delivery schedule for next week.

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: Much better, thank you. Mr. Khoa is in a meeting until three o'clock.

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: I see. Could you give me his extension number so I can try again later?

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: It is one two four. Or I can ask him to return a call.

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: That would be great. Please tell him the delivery date has changed to Friday.

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: Noted. Should I also invite you to the conference call tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: Nam (Admin Officer)
lines.text: Yes please, and I will get back to you with the final quantity today.

lines.speaker: Thu (Partner Coordinator)
lines.text: Perfect. Before we hang up, let me repeat your phone number for confirmation.

questions.q: Why does Thu ask Nam to speak up?
What is Mr. Khoa's extension number?
What has changed in the plan?
